text: To simulate the slow composition, import the `time` module and use `time.sleep(2)` inside your `compose_poem` function.
`collections.OrderedDict` behaves like a normal dictionary but remembers the order in which keys were inserted. This is perfect for an LRU cache.
When you have a 'Cache Hit', you need to update the item's position to show it was recently used. With `OrderedDict`, you can do this by calling `self.cache.move_to_end(topic)`.

When you have a 'Cache Miss' and the cache is full, you need to remove the oldest item. You can do this by calling `self.cache.popitem(last=False)`. Setting `last=False` removes the first item inserted, which is the least recently used.
